approvalReason: Canvas Helper and Brightspace sidecar observations repeatedly showed that wrong-repo, stale, wrong-cwd, wrong-branch, wrong-commit, or wrong-worktree command evidence must not verify target repo claims. Existing command-evidence fixtures plus a new regression eval cover the reusable proof boundary.

promotedPattern.name: target_repo_command_proof_boundary
promotedPattern.summary: Command evidence can verify a claim only when it is collected for the target repo, target cwd, current branch, current commit, and current auditable worktree. Wrong-repo, wrong-cwd, wrong-branch, wrong-commit, stale, wrong-worktree, human-pasted, or Codex-reported command output cannot become strong local proof.
rejectOrDowngradeConditions: Codex-reported command output without local STAX provenance
forbiddenPromotionContent: local paths beyond generic target-repo/cwd concepts

regressionEvidence.expectedResult: wrong-repo command evidence routes to proof_boundary_rule and eval promotion
runtime planning output preserves the target-repo command-proof boundary
wrong-repo command evidence cases are not strong local proof
wrong-repo command output is classified as wrong_repo_proof
only verified current local STAX command evidence can become strong proof
Brightspace wrong-repo command-evidence smoke produced zero critical miss

expectedFutureBehaviorChange: Future proof-gate reviews reject or downgrade command evidence that does not match the target repo/cwd/branch/commit/worktree and ask for fresh STAX-collected target-repo evidence.
